# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

We actively issue security updates and patches for the following versions:

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 0.1.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 0.1   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We take the security of **Grova** seriously. If you discover a security vulnerability, please do **NOT** open a public issue. Instead, follow these steps:

1. Send an email to security/maintainer at [ranitmanik.dev@gmail.com](mailto:ranitmanik.dev@gmail.com) or open a [Private Security Advisory](https://github.com/RanitManik/Grova/security/advisories/new).
2. Include full details of the vulnerability, steps to reproduce, and potential impact.
3. We will acknowledge receipt of your report within 24–48 hours and work on a resolution.

Thank you for helping keep Grova safe and secure for everyone!
